## Introduction

##Problem Statement

## What you'll build

A system that watches dashcam footage and flags riders without helmets — 
detecting motorcycles, riders, and helmets frame by frame, tracking them 
across time, and deciding on a violation only when the evidence holds up.

Then we make it run on a device small enough to sit in a vehicle.

## Before you start

You need a Google account and a browser. Nothing to install.

Every hands-on page has a badge at the top that opens that section in 
Google Colab, where the code runs on Google's machines rather than yours.

## How the pages work

Some pages you run, some you watch:

- **Run along** — Setup and the four Walkthrough sections. Open the Colab 
  link and follow.
- **Watch** — Edge Deployment. These need an NVIDIA Jetson board, so they're 
  demonstrated rather than followed.
